name: Mrs. Sewall
bio: Mrs. Sewall arrived from Maine in August 1885 with Wilmot Dow and his wife and settled at the Elkhorn ranch. Later that month she and Mrs. Dow joined their husbands in welcoming a Bad Lands excursion party there.

moments.label: Arrived from Maine for the Elkhorn ranch
Welcomed an excursion party at Elkhorn

mentions: Wilmot Dow and wife arrived from Maine last Sunday evening in company with Mrs. Sewall. They are now at home at the Elkhorn ranch.
